high_level_description: The image shows the unveiling of the first operational prototype of the rifle "Ugram" at the Armament and Combat Engineering Systems of the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) in Pune. The rifle is displayed prominently on a wooden stand within a red-framed display case with a yellow base. The rifle itself appears to be an assault rifle, featuring a black finish, a stock, and a magazine. The background includes a curtain and part of a signboard that reads "TECHNICAL," suggesting a formal presentation or exhibition setting.
